#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>

int main() {
    int n, m;
    std::cin >> n >> m;
    std::vector<unsigned long> a(n);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        std::cin >> a[i];
    }

    int half_point = n / 2;
    std::vector<unsigned long> part_a, part_b;

    // Generate all sums for the first half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_all_sums = [&](int i, unsigned long current_sum) {
        if (i == half_point) {
            part_a.push_back(current_sum);
        } else {
            generate_all_sums(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m);
            generate_all_sums(i + 1, current_sum);
        }
    };

    // Generate all sums for the second half
    std::function<void(int, unsigned long)> generate_all_sums_rest = [&](int i, unsigned long current_sum) {
        if (i == n) {
            part_b.push_back(current_sum);
        } else {
            generate_all_sums_rest(i + 1, (current_sum + a[i]) % m);
            generate_all_sums_rest(i + 1, current_sum);
        }
    };

    generate_all_sums(0, 0);
    generate_all_sums_rest(half_point, 0);

    // Remove duplicates and sort
    std::sort(part_a.begin(), part_a.end());
    auto last = std::unique(part_a.begin(), part_a.end());
    part_a.erase(last, part_a.end());

    unsigned long max_total = 0;
    for (auto val : part_b) {
        auto it = std::lower_bound(part_a.begin(), part_a.end(), m - val);
        if (it != part_a.begin()) {
            --it;
            unsigned long candidate_sum = *it + val;
            if (candidate_sum > max_total) {
                max_total = candidate_sum;
            }
        }
    }

    std::cout << max_total << "\n";

    return 0;
}
